verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Drive API supports watching resources and receiving push notifications only when a resource changes, which implies a change-tracking mechanism rather than full re-crawl, but the evidence never explicitly describes the changes.list/startPageToken cursor/delta endpoint or its pagination semantics that developers would rely on for incremental sync. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Changes API's pageToken/startPageToken mechanism, examples of delta responses, and independent/hands-on confirmation of efficient incremental sync in practice.
